ptḥ: ptḥ — Ptah, the creator-craftsman god of Memphis (god's name; Budge: Ptaḥ)
wḥꜥ: wḥꜥ — to loosen, untie, release (verb; Budge: uāu)
biꜣ: biꜣ — iron, metal (noun m.; biꜣ n pt 'iron of heaven', metal fallen from the sky; Budge: bàat)
sḫmt: sḫmt — Sekhmet, 'the Mighty One', the lion-headed goddess (god's name; from sḫm 'be mighty'; Budge: Seχet)
imy-wrt: imy-wrt — the west side, the West; first the starboard side of a boat (noun; also written feminine, imt-wrt; Budge: àmt urt)
swt: swt — but, however (enclitic particle, setting off the words before it; Budge: sut) · the same letters also write the name of Seth (filed under stẖ)
wꜥrt: wꜥrt — leg, thigh (noun f.; written with the leg sign; Budge: uārt)
wnš: wnš — jackal, wolf (noun m.; plural wnšw; Budge: unśu 'wolves')
bḥnt: bḥnt — hyena (?) (noun f.; plural bḥnwt; the sense is only a guess from Budge's beḥennu and the dog sign)
btn: btn — to be swift, be quick (verb 3-lit.; btnw 'swifter', in a comparison with r 'than'; Budge: betennu)
ṯsm: ṯsm — hound, hunting dog (noun m.; plural ṯsmw; Budge: θesem 'greyhound')
ḫꜣḫ: ḫꜣḫ — to be fast, swift (verb; ḫꜣḫ r 'faster than'; Budge: χᵃχ)
šwyt: šwyt — light, brightness (?) (noun f.; with the sun as classifier; perhaps from šw 'sunlight'; Budge: śuit) · a second word of the same spelling: shade, shadow (noun f.)
rwd: rwd — to be firm, hard, strong (verb; a later spelling of rwḏ; Budge: ruṭ)
ꜥqy: ꜥqy — rope(s) of a boat's tackle, rigging (?) (noun m.; word and sense uncertain; Budge: āqi 'sail and rudder ropes')
mḥyt: mḥyt — the north wind (noun f.; the sail as classifier; Budge: meḥit)
š-nsrt: š-nsrt — Lake of Fire, the fiery lake of the world below (place name; š 'lake, pool' + nsrt 'flame'; Budge: Śe-nesert)
isk: isk — now, see, behold (particle opening a statement; a form of ist; Budge: àsk)
srf: srf — heat, warmth (noun m.; the flame as classifier; Budge: seref)
ipn: ipn — these (masculine plural demonstrative, before or after its noun; Budge: àpen)

__broaden__.nwt: nwt — Nut, the sky-goddess, mother of the sun and of Osiris (god's name; Budge: Nut) · a second word of the same spelling: bonds, wrappings (?) (noun f. plural; Budge: netu) · a third word (?): a weapon or tool (noun f.; doubtful; Budge: nut(?))
__broaden__.rd: rd — foot, leg (noun; dual rd·fy "his two feet") · a second word of the same spelling: to grow (verb) · also thigh (?) (rtw, written with t for d; the sense is only a guess)
__broaden__.ḫr: ḫr — to fall (verb) · a second word of the same spelling: to, near, with (preposition; of persons) · also 'before' (ḫr nṯrw 'before the gods') · a third word: the particle ḫr, which brings in a further case or a consequence (?) (particle; sometimes written ẖr) · also 'from' (of persons: ḫr s nty·f ḫr·f 'from the man with whom it is')
__broaden__.r: r — to, towards, into, at (preposition); with an infinitive "in order to"; with the sḏmt·f "until"; after an imperative, with a suffix (ir·k), "yourself, then" · a second word of the same spelling: goose, fowl (noun; the goose sign) · also against (of hostility: r·i 'against me'); concerning, about (r·f 'concerning him') · also 'than' (after an adjective or verb of quality, in a comparison: btnw r ṯsmw 'swifter than hounds')
__broaden__.sꜣḥ: sꜣḥ — toe (noun) · a second word of the same spelling: Sah, Orion, the constellation, the star form of Osiris (god's name; Budge: Saḥu)
__broaden__.sgr: sgr — to silence, make quiet (verb; causative of gr "be silent") · also the noun sgrw 'silence, stillness'
__broaden__.dmḏ: dmḏ — to unite, join together (verb; Budge: ṭemt) · also to gather, collect (dmḏ·n·i ḥkꜣw 'I have gathered the magic')
